title: wwssn-microseisms
description:
This repository asks whether ocean wave energy, as recorded in seismic microseisms, changed between 1962-78 and today, by measuring microseisms on USGS scans of World-Wide Standardized Seismographic Network film chips (about 3.7 million single-day records from 1962-78, about 5% of the archive).

Status: not started. No measurements or trends from this project are present yet.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
